pages.raw_meta: Harmonic transforms broadband delivery with innovative, cloud-native solutions, empowering providers to simplify networks and enhance multi-gigabit connectivity for a superior internet experience.
raw_blocks: Powering the Future of Broadband

Harmonic, the global leader in virtualized broadband, is transforming how operators deliver multi-gigabit connectivity. Our industry-leading cloud-native cOS™ platform featuring AI-powered network intelligence and end-to-end managed services empower broadband service providers to simplify their networks. We enable operators worldwide to streamline operations, boost revenues and ensure that subscribers enjoy a superior, reliable internet experience. Backed by a massive global deployment footprint and a legacy of innovation, Harmonic is the trusted partner for the next generation of broadband.
Revolutionizing broadband networks with market‑leading technology

Harmonic is driving the market to multi-gigabit broadband services and greener operations. We develop cloud-native, virtualized broadband solutions to make intelligent connectivity possible and provide a pathway to a 10G future.
Harmonic is accelerating DAA deployment with market-leading virtualized cOS™ Broadband Platform and family of network edge devices.
Paving the way to 10G symmetrical services
Harmonic is empowering broadband service providers to leverage existing networks to deploy 10G fiber-based services to areas that make the most sense for their business.
Our customers get 24/7 support from our DevOps and support teams to power their ability to reach business objectives without the hassle of complex infrastructures.
TAKE A GLANCE AT OUR CUSTOMERS
We value creativity, innovation, integrity & respect

We have a passion for developing innovative solutions that address the industry challenges of today and tomorrow. Our investments in R&D have been rewarded with numerous patents and awards. We don't just sell products; we make broadband operations simpler and faster.
Innovate, create & accelerate with us

Our technology and innovation are the powerhouse behind some of the largest cable and broadband providers around the world. Are you one of the bright talents we are looking for to support our global leadership? Join us in our exciting journey and become part of our unique and globally diverse team.

pages.raw_meta: Harmonic cOS fiber broadband solutions allow telecom operators to deliver multigigabit service excellence to more subscribers over long distances with less equipment.
raw_blocks: Versatile fiber broadband solutions for telcos

Deliver fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) broadband services with greater agility to reach more subscribers over longer distances with cOS broadband platform . The cOS platform is a virtualized core running on commercial off the shelf servers (COTS) and powers a broad range of versatile network devices for centralized and distributed architectures. The flexibility of the cOS platform gives you agility today and capacity for the future, with greater freedom of choice. With the cOS platform you get GPON, XGS-PON and Combo PON for the versatility you need to accelerate time to market and enhance your fiber services to stay relevant in a competitive broadband market.
Leverage GPON, XGS-PON and Combo PON with ease to simplify upgrades, bring enhanced services to your subscribers in any service area, and stay ahead of your competition.

Choose ONU/Ts on your own terms. Whether to maximize value from existing consumer premise equipment (CPEs) or to deploy new CPEs, the cOS platform's open ONU/T capability ensures freedom and CPE pricing leverage.
Flexibility today, capacity for the future
Software features and capacity are easily upgraded with the cOS platform, saving money on hardware investment and accelerating new deployments and the rollout of enhanced services.
Versatile middle-mile and edge devices

Harmonic's remote OTL devices and hardened shelves are built to address a variety of deployment scenarios. Whether for ultra low or ultra high density options you gain much needed flexibility to serve both urban and rural communities most effectively.
Differentiate your service offering and save on OPEX with the power of software
Get more info about cOS fiber solutions

Deliver multigigabit, enterprise-class connectivity across thousands of kilometers of middle-mile network to reach subscribers in underserved and rural areas with the cOS platform and powerful network edge devices using long-range, Coherent optics.

Reduce permitting and construction hassles with the cOS platform and its family of OLT devices, accelerating fiber deployments and upgrades in brownfield, and greenfield. In both centralized and distributed architectures you can to bring high-speed service anywhere.

Harmonic supports local initiatives to enable internet access to all, including the Broadband Equity Access and Development (BEAD) and Build America, Buy America (BABA) programs in the U.S. with compliant solutions that facilitate deployments.

Support for multiple access technologies and third-party applications
Powerful web applications ensuring optimal network performance and always-on service

We have a team of experts who are ready to work alongside your operators, technicians and engineers. We can support your network planning, deployment, installation, configuration, troubleshooting and maintenance 24/7/365.
